title: New Technologies to Determine Carotid Plaque Vulnerability in Patients With Significant Carotid Plaques
brief_summary: The researchers are trying to determine if the characterization of "vulnerable" carotid artery plaques can be accomplished with ultrasound-based methods that look for vessels in the plaque and measure the plaque stiffness.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subject has carotid plaque with \> 50% stenosis
* Subject is able to understand the study procedure and provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subject is pregnant or breast feeding
* Subject is unable to provide informed consent
* Subject has contraindication to the use of the Lumason contrast agent.
